Assigned sample record output/samples/records/W2015391739.json: the retained firm-year period is 1963-1990 (physical paper p. 12); the four assigned fits are Table 2 Panel A/B columns (2)/(3) on physical p. 20 in output/models/records/W2015391739.json.

Accepted predecessor output/reproductions/packages/W2015391739/attempt_02: build.sas, stata.ipynb, submission.json and outcome.json; saved Table 2 panel tables supply the original 1963-1990 reconstructed estimates. The accepted handoff imports SAS and asserts isid gvkey fyear.

Accepted attempt_02 Stata handoff column metadata: fyear is numeric (%10.0g), and the DTA contains gvkey, fyear, x, r_actual and r_sim; the extended handoff preserved these fields and passed the same isid assertion.
changes: Rebuilt the original and added observations jointly on the accepted Compustat fiscal-year clock; extended the annual filter from 1963-1990 through 1995.
Extended the accepted CRSP MSF calendar-date cap from 1991-12-31 to 1996-12-31 while keeping the original 1962 lower bound and FYE-9/FYE-8 through FYE+3 windows.
Kept the four accepted Table 2 OLS fits, within-year trimming, date-valid CCM/CRSP joins, pooled actual-return generator, one-draw same-year residual rotation, and seed unchanged.

Added inline Stata e(sample) counts for original and added fiscal-year ranges and one computed EXT_SAMPLE marker per fit; preserved the stable cell IDs and verified fyear as numeric in the accepted Stata handoff metadata.

Declared the fresh pooled handoff at data/basu_replication_1963_1995.sas7bdat and data/basu_replication_1963_1995/reg.dta; placed the native panel result tables under work/artifacts for hash-bound report evidence.
Removed the accepted SAS copy's single-GVKEY row-level diagnostic queries and retained aggregate fiscal-year/currency diagnostics so the run and report expose only aggregate source evidence.
limitations: The predecessor's accepted 1963-1990 reconstruction already differed substantially from the paper's Table 2 sample sizes: Panel A bad-news actual/simulated N=39,201/39,140 versus the paper's 20,618/20,498, and Panel B good-news actual/simulated N=50,787/50,848 versus 29,333/29,453 (paper p. 20; saved predecessor tables and model record). Its full handoff had 89,988 rows versus Table 1 Panel A's 49,951; this inherited discrepancy remains unresolved. The extension compares to that saved accepted run and adds no screens to approach the paper's N.

The accepted simulated-return construction estimates one pooled actual-return-on-X generator. Re-estimating it on 1963-1995 changes the simulated sign partitions within 1963-1990: the bad-news old-period count is 39,233 versus 39,140 in the saved prior fit, and the good-news old-period count is 50,755 versus 50,848. The combined period counts come from the active pooled fits and the change follows the retained generator construction.

The bounded current EXRAT12M source has no GBP-origin quotes before January 1982. The accepted route therefore leaves 7,266 selected CAD annual rows without conversion across the pooled 1963-1995 inputs; the native constructor retains missingness and does not substitute another source or impute rates. Added years 1991-1995 have statement-month rate coverage.

Current COMP.FUNDA.IB is a provider mapping to annual A18, but historical vintage, restatement and exact definition equivalence to the paper's Compustat item 18 remain uncertain. The paper's Table 1 note says stock price while Table 2 p. 20 says firm market value; the accepted design follows Table 2 and uses company MVE at FYE-9.

The paper does not uniquely report the regression estimator, covariance correction, sidedness, or simulation seed. The accepted OLS with ordinary inference and fixed seed 20261103 are retained. Current-vintage CRSP/CCM links and the source-silent issue/share-class composition of company market equity remain limitations documented in work/design.md.

Only the accepted single-draw same-year residual permutation is retained; later simulation repetitions, fixed-slope robustness analyses, later-period paper columns and Table 3 are outside the four assigned scopes.
